facts.business: Subam Papers Limited operates in the paper carry bag and paper packaging industry in India, manufacturing paper bags for retail, e-commerce, food delivery, pharmaceuticals, and FMCG sectors.

capacity_or_capex.item: Revaluation of Land, Plant and Machinery

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matters: 1) Contingent liability relating to MSME litigation with Jeyam Chemicals (₹1.36 crore claim, ₹0.25 crore deposited). 2) Assessment of carrying value of PPE during Ind AS transition with potential revaluation in FY 2026-27.

key_risks: Ongoing litigation with Jeyam Chemicals before Hon'ble High Court (MSME dispute)
Ind AS transition and potential revaluation of Property, Plant and Equipment
Dependence on regulatory mandates for plastic ban enforcement
Raw material price volatility in paper/pulp
High capacity utilization (95%+) in Indian paper industry limiting supply flexibility
